html: I’m happy to announce that MacLeod Andrews, who has been the voice for six of my seven Rho Agenda Novels, has signed on to perform the audio book for The Altreian Enigma. It is great to have him available for this release.

comments.author: Vernon
comments.html: That is awesome news. Any idea when the audiobook will be available?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Yes it is. The audiobook will be released at the same time as the Kindle and paperbacks come out (December 6th, 2016)

comments.author: David
comments.html: That’s great news. It just wasn’t the same without him. Now you just need him to go back and re-do the Kasari Nexus. The OCD in me screams that its the only one with a different voice. lol

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Yes. MacLeod was not available for that one but doubt that my publisher will pay for a redo. Alexander Cendese is a very accomplished voice actor but it was a big change from the other six of my books that MacLeod has done.

comments.author: Patrick Mann
comments.html: That is great news. I can’t hear Jack in any other voice but his. He literally is Jack’s voice. It is the perfect convergence of voice and character personally.
